market_summary: London session displays balanced, range-bound behavior across EURUSD and US100 with price oscillating within session Value Areas and near VWAP/EMA baselines. BTCUSD experienced a sharp impulsive breakdown below VAL and its lower ATR band, but the lack of an RVOL > 2.0 volume climax and extreme lower-band stretch warrants holding off on short chases.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 1.10779, VAH 1.10998) and below POC (1.10943), suggesting mean-reverting chop. CVD is NEUTRAL (+2,361) with a negative short-term slope (-4018.76). In the LONDON_SESSION, price is hovering right around VWAP (1.10863) and EMA50 (1.10896) within the mid-channel of the ATR bands. RVOL is standard (1.072) with no yellow volume confirmation following a rejection from S/R 1.11007 and Session High 1.11027. GEX is null. Lacking directional confluence.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral hovering near VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: rejection of S/R at 1.11007 and Session High

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 28086.57, VAH 28185.57) and holding above POC (28121.92). CVD is BEARISH (-2.97) with a slight negative slope (-0.23). In LONDON_SESSION, price sits slightly above VWAP (28132.62) but remains directly beneath the falling EMA50 (28161.74) mid-channel. RVOL is low at 0.889 (US100 tick volume caveat noted, but no structural catalyst present). GEX is null. With price trapped between S/R 28100.36 support and overhead EMA50 resistance inside VA, the prudent stance is to wait.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: neutral consolidating above VWAP but capped by EMA50
signals.level_event: none, consolidating between S/R 28100.36 and EMA50

signals.rationale: Price is trading well below VAL (73338.96) and below POC (73536.49) following an impulsive breakdown. CVD is BEARISH (-0.06) with negative slope (-0.01) aligning with the downside move. In LONDON_SESSION, price is firmly below both descending VWAP (73571.4) and EMA50 (73538.46). The signal candle penetrated deeply through the lower ATR band (72990.54), stretching into Session Low (72812.20). RVOL expanded to 1.521 but printed no yellow spike (>2.0), leaving the heavy extension vulnerable to mean-reversion snapbacks without clean continuation room.
signals.trend_vs_vwap: bearish strong flush below VWAP and EMA50
signals.level_event: breakout below Prev Low 73097.3 into Session Low 72812.2
